# PanelPay

> PanelPay is a prepaid cloud panel for people and businesses in Bangladesh. You buy Cloud Servers, built on Amazon Lightsail, that run in the AWS Region Singapore or Mumbai. Prices are in taka (BDT) and include VAT and fees; you pay from a taka wallet that you top up with EPS. PanelPay sells, bills and supports the service.

> PanelPay বাংলাদেশের মানুষ ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের জন্য একটি প্রিপেইড ক্লাউড প্যানেল। এখানে Amazon Lightsail দিয়ে তৈরি ক্লাউড সার্ভার কেনা যায়, যা Singapore বা Mumbai AWS Region থেকে চলে। মূল্য টাকায় (BDT) এবং তাতে VAT ও ফি অন্তর্ভুক্ত; পরিশোধ হয় টাকার ওয়ালেট থেকে, যা EPS দিয়ে টপ আপ করা যায়। বিক্রি, বিল ও সাপোর্ট PanelPay দেয়।

Canonical site: https://tryaws.now
Published by PanelPay
Last updated: 2026-11-15

## Key facts

- What: Every server, database and storage resource you buy here is an Amazon Lightsail resource running in an AWS Region (Singapore or Mumbai). PanelPay sells, bills and supports the service. You manage everything from this panel and do not need an AWS account.
- Locations: Singapore (ap-southeast-1), Mumbai (ap-south-1)
- Prices: Prices are in taka (BDT), for 30 days, and include VAT and fees. You pay from your taka wallet, and you see the amount before you confirm. 100% AWS infrastructure. Built on Amazon Lightsail.
- Support: PanelPay gives support through support requests only, and our support team answers every request in writing. With an account, open a request in the panel and follow the answers there. Without an account, use the form on the support page and we answer by email. There is no support phone line and no support email address.
- Company: PanelPay, Level 1, Example House, 1 Example Avenue, Sector-1, Example Area, Dhaka-1000
- Identifiers: BIN: 000000000-0000, Trade License: TRAD/DNCC/000000/2000
- Machine-readable facts: https://tryaws.now/facts.json
- Full text: https://tryaws.now/llms-full.txt
